description: Aree percorse dal fuoco (RU) - Comune di Fiesole is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.055055.it. Land register of areas covered by fire – Provisions for the prevention of forest fires (Articles 75a and 76 of Regional Law No 39/2000). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Areas covered by fire (RU) - Municipality of Fiesole" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include geodata, Regolamento Urbanistico, pianificazione. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
